This is a reasoning-action mismatch: the agent’s declared plan (in-document verification) diverged from the action taken (off-source web search), which seeded a false lead that cascaded through later steps and culminated in the wrong final answer. This aligns with FM-2.6 (Reasoning-Action Mismatch) as the inconsistency between the planned method and the actual execution caused the undesired outcome.
